Summary: Checks that Microsoft Entra users have the attributes HR processes, dynamic groups and licensing depend on (usage location, manager, employee ID, hire date, address, sponsors for guests), and that phone numbers, countries and names are formatted consistently. Read-only.

Prerequisites.Text: An account or app that can read users and group members in Microsoft Graph (User.Read.All and GroupMember.Read.All; Directory.Read.All covers both).

Steps.Text: To include employee hire dates (MP.CLT.UA.1006), connect with the extra scope instead. Without it, that test reports Investigate.

Notes: Connect-Maester does not ask for User-LifeCycleInfo.Read.All. Every other test works with the scopes it asks for.

Commands.Text: Maester's own tests and this pack
Leave out the fields many organisations don't use (business phone, mobile, fax, office location)
List every failing user for one test instead of the first 100

Notes: Set the options below per test in maester-config.json under TestSettings, for example { "Id": "MP.CLT.UA.1001", "Parameters": { "ExcludedGroups": ["<group object id>"] } }.

Options.Name: ExcludedUsers (every test)
Options.Text: User principal names or object IDs to leave out, such as break-glass and service accounts.

Options.Name: ExcludedGroups (every test)
Options.Text: Object IDs of groups whose members, including nested members, are left out.

Options.Name: MaxRows (every test)
Options.Text: Most users or rows listed in a result. 0 lists them all.

Options.Name: MP.CLT.UA.1002 ExcludedJobTitles
Options.Text: Job titles at the top of the organisation, which have no manager.

Options.Name: MP.CLT.UA.1008 Fields
Options.Text: Address fields that must be set. officeLocation can be added.

Options.Name: MP.CLT.UA.1010 IgnoreLeadingZeros
Options.Text: Treat employee IDs that differ only in leading zeros as the same ID.

Options.Name: MP.CLT.UA.1011 AllowSpaces
Options.Text: Allow spaces inside phone numbers, such as +1 425 555 0100.

Options.Name: MP.CLT.UA.1011 PhonePattern
Options.Text: Regular expression a phone number must match (E.164 by default).

Options.Name: MP.CLT.UA.1013 AllowedCountries
Options.Text: The exact country spellings your organisation uses, such as United States.

AppOnly.Text: Give the app the application permissions User.Read.All and GroupMember.Read.All, and User-LifeCycleInfo.Read.All for hire dates. The pack only reads.
